statements.attributed: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) are composed of five or more equiatomic or near-equiatomic components, forming a simple solid solution phase.
statements.quote: Among them, high-entropy alloys (HEAs) are composed of five or more equiatomic or near-equiatomic components, forming a simple solid solution phase. Different from traditional alloys, multi-component HEAs are the result of the interaction of multiple principal elements, rather than the unique properties of a single element, with the structural characteristics of disordered occupation and ordered lattice. High-entropy alloying has been widely used in the design of electrocatalysts because of rich elemental composition, adjustable electronic structure, and unique physical and chemical properties

statements.attributed: The BCC structure has high strength and brittleness, and the HCP structure is less reported in electrocatalysis.
statements.quote: Furthermore, it has excellent electrical conductivity and optimized electronic structure, which is superior to the FCC structure counterpart in the OER and HER. The HCP structure (such as IrOsReRhRu) is less reported in electrocatalysis.

statements.attributed: The lattice distortion effect refers to the phenomenon that the bond length and bond angle between adjacent atoms in the crystal structure are distorted.
statements.quote: The lattice distortion effect refers to the phenomenon that the bond length and bond angle between adjacent atoms in the crystal structure are distorted. The displacement of each lattice site depends on the atoms occupying the site and the type of atoms in the local environment. This effect causes inhomogeneity in the same layer of atomic planes, resulting in obvious Bragg scattering of X-rays on uneven crystal planes, thereby weakening and broadening the XRD peaks of HEAs.

statements.attributed: A method for preparing high-entropy alloys by fast moving bed pyrolysis (FMBP) was proposed.
statements.quote: To overcome the dependence on the conductivity of the carrier, Lu et al. proposed a method for preparing HEAs by fast moving bed pyrolysis (FMBP). They quickly put the metal precursor into a high-temperature tube furnace at 923 K within 5 s, and the mixed metal precursor was pyrolyzed at the same time to form HEA-NPs without phase separation (Fig. 2a).

statements.attributed: The low free energy of the nucleus and the rapid nucleation rate during the FMBP process ensure the formation of highly dispersed and uniform high-entropy alloys.
statements.quote: The low free energy of the nucleus and the rapid nucleation rate during the FMBP process ensure the formation of highly dispersed and uniform HEAs.

statements.attributed: The lattice distortion of AlCoCrFeNiW HEA can be verified by XAFS analysis.
statements.quote: Wu et al. verified the lattice distortion of AlCoCrFeNiW HEA by XAFS analysis. As shown in Fig. 3e, the spectral positions of all elements in AlCoCrFeNiW HEA deviate from the standard sample, indicating that there is a huge lattice distortion.

statements.attributed: The catalytic activity of nanoporous CuAlNiMoFe electrode is about 46 and 14 times higher than that of CuNi and CuAlNi electrodes, respectively.
statements.quote: Jiang et al. prepared a nanoporous CuAlNiMoFe electrode, whose catalytic activity is about 46 and 14 times higher than that of CuNi and CuAlNi electrodes, respectively. HEAs have higher catalytic activity perhaps due to their rich active sites and high configuration entropy.

statements.attributed: PtRuNiCoFeMo HEA sub-nanowires have high performance for alkaline hydrogen oxidation reaction (HOR).
statements.quote: Huang et al. prepared PtRuNiCoFeMo HEA sub-nanowires (SNW) for alkaline hydrogen oxidation reaction (HOR). The pin-on reaction at Fe and Mo sites, the highly stable valence state of Co and Ni sites, and the high activity of Pt and Ru sites contribute to the high performance of SNW, indicating that different metal sites have different effects (Fig. 4b).

statements.attributed: Pt34Fe5Ni20Cu31Mo9Ru HEA has overpotentials of 20 mV and 259 mV at 10 mA cm−2 for the HER and OER, respectively.

statements.quote: Kang et al. prepared Pt34Fe5Ni20Cu31Mo9Ru HEA with convex cubic nanocrystals (Fig. 4c). In 1 M KOH, the overpotentials of Pt34Fe5Ni20Cu31Mo9Ru HEA for the HER and OER are 20 mV and 259 mV at 10 mA cm−2, respectively.

statements.attributed: prepared RuFeCoNiCu HEA NPs for the NRR
statements.quote: Zhang et al. prepared RuFeCoNiCu HEA NPs for the NRR (Fig. 4e). At a low overpotential of 0.05 V, the Faraday efficiency of the HEA NPs was 38.5%, and there was no significant attenuation after 100 h of continuous operation.

statements.attributed: prepared PdFeCoNiCu NPs for alkaline HER
statements.quote: The random distribution of various elements in a single phase will produce serious lattice distortion and inherent synergistic effects, which can regulate the electronic state and coordination environment. Lei et al. prepared PdFeCoNiCu NPs for alkaline HER, which exhibited a low overpotential of 18 mV at 10 mA cm−2. DFT calculations showed that the synergistic effect between various metals in the HEA optimized the electronic structure.

statements.attributed: prepared hollow HEA nanoparticles as cathode catalysts for Li–O2 batteries
statements.quote: Gao et al. prepared hollow HEA nanoparticles as cathode catalysts for Li–O2 batteries. The stability results showed that the hollow HEA remained intact after 80 cycles and more than 300 h cycles.

statements.attributed: used non-noble metal FeCoNiCu HEA nanoparticles to stabilize noble metal Pt
statements.quote: Yao et al. used non-noble metal FeCoNiCu HEA nanoparticles to stabilize noble metal Pt and load it on carbonized wood. As shown in Fig. 4i, HEA@Pt exhibited better stability than commercial Pt/C and Pt, and maintained the performance and structural stability after 100 h of continuous testing.

statements.attributed: used a simple machine learning algorithm to predict the adsorption energy of the key intermediates (*OH and *O) of IrPdPtRhRu HEA in the ORR

statements.attributed: plotted the HER electrocatalytic volcano map by calculation
statements.quote: According to the Sabatier principle, the best catalytic activity can only be achieved when the intermediate adsorption reaches equilibrium. The HER electrocatalytic volcano map was plotted by calculation as shown in Fig. 6a. The noble metal Pt is the metal element closest to the vertex of the volcanic map, which is mainly due to its d9 electronic structure with moderate intermediate adsorption energy.

statements.attributed: prepared PdPtRhIrCu HEA with rich lattice distortion and defects by a simple hydrothermal synthesis method
statements.quote: Mao et al. prepared PdPtRhIrCu HEA with rich lattice distortion and defects by a simple hydrothermal synthesis method. The overpotential of PdPtRhIrCu HEA at 10 mA cm−2 is only 15 mV, which is attributed to the ultra-thin high-entropy structure with lattice distortion and defects, which can provide ultra-high specific surface area, maximum atomic utilization and active surface metal atoms, thus promoting the adsorption and dissociation of reaction intermediates.

statements.attributed: enhanced the proportion of the BCC phase by increasing the proportion of Cr
statements.quote: Wang et al. enhanced the proportion of the BCC phase by increasing the proportion of Cr, which led to the relative downshift of the Fermi level of Cr1.5MnFeNi (Fig. 6i). This will lead to the relative movement of the anti-bonding state and the weakening of the bonding, thereby fine-tuning the adsorption energy of HER intermediates.

statements.attributed: doped atomic P into monolithic porous Ni30Co30Fe10Cr10Al18W2 HEA
statements.quote: Chen et al. doped atomic P into monolithic porous Ni30Co30Fe10Cr10Al18W2 HEA (Fig. 6j), which resulted in atomic lattice expansion and internal strain in the HEA. In Fig. 6k, it is clearly observed that a P-doped HEA has wider lattice stretching strain distribution than the undoped HEA.

statements.attributed: prepared ZnNiCoIrX (X = Fe or Mn) by using Ni and Co as effective alloying elements and Zn as a sacrificial element
statements.quote: Kwon et al. prepared ZnNiCoIrX (X = Fe or Mn) by using Ni and Co as effective alloying elements and Zn as a sacrificial element. The combination of ZnNiCoMn adjusts the electronic structure of the Ir site and modifies the cohesive energy and adsorption energy.

statements.attributed: selected transition metal elements (Ni2+, Cr3+, Fe3+, Mo6+) with similar atomic radii and different valence states to prepare RuNiMoCrFeOx/CNT with oxygen vacancies by a solvent-free microwave method
statements.quote: Yu et al. selected transition metal elements (Ni2+, Cr3+, Fe3+, Mo6+) with similar atomic radii and different valence states to prepare RuNiMoCrFeOx/CNT with oxygen vacancies by a solvent-free microwave method. High entropy lattice oxygen participates in the reaction, and LOM dominates the OER process.

statements.attributed: the addition of transition metals such as Cr, Mn, and V is beneficial to improve OER activity
statements.quote: Li et al. found that the addition of transition metals such as Cr, Mn, and V is beneficial to improve OER activity. More importantly, the addition of Cr can promote higher oxidation state of active elements such as Co, Ni, and Fe, thereby reducing the OER overpotential.

statements.attributed: prepared CrMnFeCoNi HEA with twin defects by means of a single metal doping quaternary system
statements.quote: Ren et al. prepared CrMnFeCoNi HEA with twin defects by means of a single metal doping quaternary system. The introduction of metal elements distorts the lattice and produces dislocations, especially twins, leading to strong distortion and modulation of surface electronic states.

statements.attributed: bimetallic PtM (PtCo, PtPd, PtNi, PtCu, etc.) composed of Pt alloy and transition metal can optimize the d-band center and adjust the electronic structure through the ‘ligand effect’ and ‘strain effect’
statements.quote: Bimetallic PtM (PtCo, PtPd, PtNi, PtCu, etc.) composed of Pt alloy and transition metal can optimize the d-band center and adjust the electronic structure through the ‘ligand effect’ and ‘strain effect’. Unlike binary alloys, HEAs with complex composition due to the random distribution of atoms with different radii can regulate the electronic structure in a wider range, and can greatly reduce the use of precious metals and reduce costs.

statements.attributed: prepared three high-entropy materials, CrMnFeCoNi, CuMnFeCoNi and MnFeCoNi, to verify the factors affecting the properties of HEAs

statements.quote: Cavin et al. prepared layered high-entropy transition metal disulfides using Mo, W, V, Nb and Ta metals. DFT calculations showed that the 2D high-entropy metal sulfide had a multi-site synergistic catalytic effect.
